honesty: What this file records is the HTTP state of seventeen URLs WE chose, not anything about the seventeen banks. Eleven of those URLs are newsroom index pages we guessed; a 404 on a path we invented is evidence about our guess, never about the bank. The primary source — Swift's own press release naming the cohort — has NOT been fetched: swift.com answers 403 to this client. No bank in this file has been measured on tokenisation posture, and none should be quoted as such.
